A torque wrench is a tool that ensures nuts or bolts are tightened to the required amount.
A mechanic sets the torque wrench to produce a moment of 50Nm.
The torque wrench has a length from the centre of the bolt to the handle of 600mm.
What is the smallest force the mechanic needs to apply to tighten the bolt correctly?
A
0.080N
B
30N
C
83N
D
30kN
subject: Physics
